powder-blue.name: Powder blue
powder-blue.usage: Primary brand field, mastheads and generous feature panels.
powder-blue.provenance: Selected 11:02 screenshot; representative flat colour sampled from its subtle gradient.

ink.usage: Headlines, primary text and solid buttons.

slate.usage: Secondary brand accents, links, numbering and restrained emphasis.

paper.usage: Raised paper surfaces and text on dark buttons.

mist.provenance: Original Roster stylesheet; first card in the reference.

ice.provenance: Original Roster stylesheet; second card in the reference.

rules: Keep every colour soft and low in saturation.
Use light surfaces for most of the composition; reserve darker colours for type and clear actions.
Use powder blue as the shared family signature. Differentiate products through hierarchy and content rather than introducing unrelated colours.
Do not use plum, mauve, burgundy or saturated crimson in this approved direction.
Use living-room photography in the homepage hero and spiral-stair photography in the lower founder section.
Use Roster Suite in all public product language. Leave legacy internal database names unchanged.

implementation_note: This records the approved palette. It does not itself recolour the current preview or deploy production. The current preview already uses powder blue #DFE5EC; other existing preview tokens may differ and should be aligned in the next styling pass.
